name: Desktop Wooden Fish
detailed_description:
Desktop Wooden Fish: A Peaceful Corner amidst the Hustle and Bustle

In the fast-paced modern life, do you long to find a peaceful corner where your tired soul can rest? "Desktop Wooden Fish" is precisely such a well-crafted casual game tailored for you. Now available on the Steam platform, it will open up a unique relaxation journey for you.

Tap with Fingertips, Release the Pressure

In the game, an exquisite wooden fish lies quietly on the screen. With just a gentle click, the crisp and pleasant tapping sound will ring out, as if transporting you through the hustle and bustle to a tranquil realm. Each tap seems to dispel the pressure and worries in your heart one by one, making your tense nerves relax instantly. When you don't want to operate manually, you can turn on the automatic tapping mode with one click. The continuous sound of the wooden fish is like a clear spring in the mountains, gurgling and flowing, accompanying you to immerse in a soothing atmosphere, allowing your whole body and mind to get deeply relaxed.

Personalized Customization, Exclusive Wishes

Here, you can freely unleash your creativity. The words of praying for blessings and insights can be customized freely. Whether it's the beautiful wish of "All Things Go Well", the inspiring words of "Come on, Keep Working Hard Today", or the private monologue deep in your heart, you can input them as you like. Each tap carries a meaning unique to you and becomes a unique way for you to convey your heart to the world.

Adaptable to Multiple Scenarios, Enjoy Peace Anytime

Whether you urgently need a moment of respite during busy work and tap a few times during the office break to quickly restore a peaceful state; or you desire to focus while studying and let the automatic tapping sound of the wooden fish help you isolate the distractions from the outside world; or when you are leisurely playing other games and hang "Desktop Wooden Fish" in the background, letting the sound of the wooden fish add a touch of tranquility to your leisure time, it can be perfectly adapted, becoming a constant source of spiritual comfort in your life.

Come and join the world of "Desktop Wooden Fish". With simple taps, start a healing journey for your soul and regain the long-lost peace in your heart.

In the game, by tapping on the wooden fish and listening to realistic sound effects, it feels like being in a serene and elegant environment. It supports automatic tapping and has customization options, allowing users to set words.
